points.description: States the perpetual (terminal/long-term) growth rate as one of the two factors, using this technical term.
States WACC (weighted average cost of capital, i.e. the discount rate) as the other factor, using this technical term.

rubric.notes: Both blanks need the exact technical terms: perpetual/terminal growth rate and WACC (discount rate). Each is worth 1 mark; vague answers such as "growth", "interest rates", "cash flows" or "assumptions" earn nothing for that point. A wrong extra item (e.g. a third factor given as an answer) costs the point it contradicts; order of the two terms does not matter.
